card.title: Return to the First Hope
card.instruction: Return to an early hope after every setback, expanding its meaning until the whole scene seems to fulfill it.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: We wanted somewhere to belong. This leaking cottage can still be ours.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Then we'll know every tile of the place we belong.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: We hoped for a home, not an untouched savings account beside someone else's house.

cardFidelity.evidence: A1 returns to belonging; A3 repair means intimacy with home; A5 spending savings becomes fulfillment rather than loss.

responseLogic.evidence: B2 roof replacement prompts A3 knowledge of tiles; B4 cost prompts A5 home over untouched savings.

relationship.evidence: B2 and B4 raise credible material barriers to purchase or repair.

heightening.evidence: A5 uses B4 financial threat to enlarge the original hope beyond ownership into commitment of resources.

specificity.evidence: A1 leaking cottage and B4 savings make the emotional hope and real risk clear.
